step.title: Step I — questions on previous knowledge
step.plan-content: Teacher asks the students some questions based on their previous knowledge while the students answer and the teacher corrects their mistakes.

step.title: Step II — properties of cubes and cuboids
step.plan-content: Teacher writes the properties of cubes and cuboids on the board for the students to take notes in their notebooks.

step.title: Step III — properties of pyramids and cones
step.plan-content: Teacher draws the pyramids and the cone on the board and writes their properties for the students to take down, as in Step II.

step.title: Evaluation
step.plan-content:
Assembled from the plan's own two in-lesson activity sets, which between them cover both objectives. This is **not** the classwork the students sat — that was set from the textbook by reference (see `_question-set.md`).
**Objective 1 — cubes and cuboids.**
1. How many vertices, has a cuboid? 2. How many edges has a cube? 3. Draw a cube and cuboid then label.
**Objective 2 — pyramids and cones.**
4. Draw an hexagonal base pyramid and list the properties. 5. How many vertices has a tetrahedron.
